name: stack-scan
description: Know what is actually installed, then keep it healthy: /stack-scan:report inventories manifests and lockfiles (composer, npm/yarn/pnpm/bun), runtimes, engine constraints and docker images into a required-vs-installed table with drift, missing locks and EOL majors flagged; /stack-scan:audit runs the composer/npm vulnerability, outdated and licence checks (package-hygiene: semver strategy, lockfile discipline, upgrade lanes, licences against the distribution mode) — report-only. Whether to add a dependency at all is approaches' build-vs-buy.
